stories.title: Ship with 270 passengers sinks off coast of Northern Cyprus — TV
stories.summary: ISTANBUL, August 30. A passenger ship carrying 270 passengers sank four miles off the coast of Northern Cyprus, TRT Haber reported. According to the TV channel, the ship capsized for unknown reasons. A search-and-rescue operation is underway in the area of the incident. There have been no reports of possible fatalities. Nearly 100 people have already been brought ashore. ccording to the authorities of the unrecognized Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC), the incident occurred around 12:00 p.m. local time (9:00 a.m. GMT). The catamaran was traveling from the port of Girne (Kyrenia) to the Turkish city of Tasucu.

A passenger boat with some 270 people on board has capsized off northern Cyprus, with a search and rescue under way, local media report.
Murat Senkul, the mayor of the coastal town of Kyrenia, told broadcaster CNN Turk that 159 of those aboard had been reached.

stories.title: Long queues mark final day as Hong Kong bookstore closes after raid
stories.summary: An independent Hong Kong bookstore has shut its doors six weeks after a national security police raid, drawing long queues of customers on its final day following four years in business. Readers wound down the dim staircase of a Prince Edward tenement building on Sunday afternoon, with some waiting up to 45 minutes to enter the third-floor bookstore, Have a Nice Stay.
